question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "productivity."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For blank 2, the correct answer is "productivity."
 
• "Productivity" means the state or quality of being productive. (उत्‍पादकता)
 
 
• Example: *A pleasant working environment increases **productivity**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3. 
 
• Correct passage :

Management like any other art can be learnt and developed. Management means managing all our __resources__ - money, material, machines and most importantly, manpower. Since we can maximise __**productivity**__ only through people they have to be treated well. ______ (3) ______ is the key to man - management. People can be forced to work but they have to be motivated to work well. People can be motivated as much through ______ (4) ______ for doing their best as through timely and brief reprimands for poor performance. In order to maximise production, a manager will have to be ‘tough and nice’, not ‘nice and tough’ because everyone needs not only to be praised but also ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Complexity: **the state of being complex and difficult to understand. (जटिलता और दुर्बोधता)
 
• **Richness: **the state of existing in or containing plentiful quantities of something desirable. (अमीरी, समृद्धि, प्रचुरता)
 
• **Affection: **a feeling of loving or liking somebody/something. (अनुराग, स्‍नेह)
